name: @mxlang/language-server
description: Diagnostics-only LSP server for MX hosts (decision 71)

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts src/bin.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --external @marko/compiler --external @mxlang/core --external @mxlang/hono --external @mxlang/html --external @mxlang/parser --external @mxlang/preact --external @mxlang/react --external @mxlang/solid --external vscode-languageserver --external vscode-languageserver-textdocument && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist
